content.text:
I fixed the tables so rows of side-by-side tables now have the same height. All changes are in [site/index.html](site/index.html).

There were two causes, and I fixed both:
- **Model names now stay on one line.** A name too long for the column is cut off with "…", and hovering shows the full name. The Model column takes whatever width the number columns leave.
- **"chef's pick" now goes on its own line** under the top model's name, in small italic. Every table has a top row, so every top row is the same height. Before, the label sat next to the name and pushed long names onto a second line.

I also gave each table a minimum width of 30rem. On narrow phones the table scrolls sideways (it already did) instead of squeezing the model names down to almost nothing.

I tested it in the browser with mock data based on your screenshot, at two-column desktop width and at phone width. In every table the first row measured 47px and the others 33px. Nothing is committed.
